directory_policies.notes.3: GRE policy: All international master applicants must submit GRE. A universal domestic rule has not been verified, so the shared automatic GRE field remains unknown.
directory_policies.notes.4: Intake policy: International applicants are instructed to apply for fall only. The standing policy alone does not identify a dated Fall 2027 cycle.
directory_policies.notes.5: Preparation: Expected preparation includes multi-semester calculus, object-oriented programming, data structures, discrete mathematics and computer organization; duration and equivalency still require review.

source_excerpt: International masters applicants must take the GRE.
fact_summary: The department identifies MCS as its non-thesis MR route and specifies international-only GRE/fall rules and preparation; category-specific rules are not generalized to everyone.
